meta.title: Journi — a journal that keeps you writing
meta.description: Journi is a simple journaling app with streak-based motivation: write daily, keep your streak alive, and protect your progress with freezes.

hero.title: A journal that keeps you writing
hero.subtitle: Write every day, keep your streak alive, and never lose your progress thanks to freezes — even when life gets in the way.
hero.download_note: Official version on Google Play with auto-updates. Or direct APK installation from GitHub — without a Google account.

items.title: Daily journal
items.desc: Write and save your thoughts, experiences, and memories in one place.

items.title: Streaks
items.desc: Track how many consecutive days you've kept your journaling habit.

items.title: Streak freezes
items.desc: Two freezes protect your streak when you miss a day. One freeze is restored after 3 consecutive days without a miss.

items.title: Notifications
items.desc: Reminders help you keep the habit going.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Journi ("the app", "we") respects your privacy. This policy explains what data the app processes and how.

sections.p: Journi stores all your journal entries, streak data, and freeze data locally on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or have access to the content of your entries — no server or account is used for this.
The app may request permission to send local push notifications as journaling reminders. This permission is used solely for reminders and is not linked to any data collection.
Journi does not use third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services.
Since all data is stored locally, uninstalling the app permanently removes all your entries and statistics. We do not keep centralized backups of your data.
Journi is not intended for use by anyone under 13 and does not knowingly collect data from children.
We may update this policy from time to time. The last update date is always shown at the top of this page.

how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Three simple steps to make the habit stick

steps.title: Write daily
steps.desc: Open the app and leave a few lines — thoughts, events, mood. Takes a minute.

steps.title: Keep your streak
steps.desc: Every day without a miss extends your streak and shows how far you've come.

steps.title: Protect your progress
steps.desc: Missed a day? A freeze automatically saves your streak — no stress, no guilt.

cta.title: Start your streak today
